note: Four mainland China options, to show that Triody moves to another country by swapping this one file. Figures were checked on 14 October 2026. Published figures are quoted in each source block. Anything not published is listed under 'assumed'. This catalogue is smaller and less checked than the UK one: it is a portability demonstration, not a market survey. Real offers depend on each provider's checks. This is information, not a quote or an offer.
reference_rate_source: One-year Loan Prime Rate 3.0%, unchanged for 16 months (TrendForce DataTrack, 1 October 2026): https://datatrack.trendforce.com/blog/content/64760/chinas-one-year-lpr-kept-unchanged-for-16-consecutive-months-steady-at-a-record-low-of-30

products.name: WeBank Weiyedai business loan (微业贷)
products.notes: Online credit line for companies, no collateral listed. The published rate range is wide (2.88% to 24%), so the rate used here is an assumption.

published: 企业贷最高额度1000万元 (company loans up to RMB 10 million)
年化利率(单利)：2.88%-24% (annual simple interest 2.88% to 24%)
可分24期还款 (repay in up to 24 instalments)
最快1分钟到账 (money in as fast as 1 minute)
最终获批额度类型、贷款额度、放款时间、利率、借款优惠等以实际审批为准 (final terms depend on approval)
Standard Chartered partnership version: for small and micro companies registered in mainland China for over one year, based on company credit and a guarantee from the legal representative
assumed: Rate by credit profile: good 6.0%, fair 10.8%, weak 18.0%. All inside the published range. The real rate is shown only at contract
Costed as an amortising loan at that rate, although WeBank quotes a simple annual rate
12 months of trading needed, taken from the partnership page
Companies only (the published RMB 10 million limit is for company loans)
The 3.6% new-customer rate lasts 7 days and the 1% interest subsidy depends on policy conditions, so neither is used

products.name: Bank inclusive small and micro business loan (market average rate)
products.notes: Costed at the national average rate for new inclusive small and micro loans, not one bank's offer.

source.provider: People's Bank of China data, as reported by Beijing Business Today
published: 普惠小微新发放贷款利率为3.57% (new inclusive small and micro loans: average rate 3.57%, June 2026)
6月企业新发放贷款加权平均利率约3% (new company loans: weighted average about 3%, June 2026)
assumed: Rate = the June 2026 national average of 3.57%. A given bank may charge more or less
A 'good' credit profile and 24 months of trading are needed to get near the average
Up to RMB 10 million per borrower, the usual ceiling for loans counted as inclusive
About 10 days from application to money

products.name: Tax payment deferral (延期缴纳税款)
products.notes: Moves a tax payment up to 3 months later. Needs approval and a reason the law accepts ('special difficulty'), so apply before the due date.

source.provider: Tax Collection Administration Law of the PRC (2015 amendment)
published: 第三十一条：纳税人因有特殊困难，不能按期缴纳税款的，经省、自治区、直辖市国家税务局、地方税务局批准，可以延期缴纳税款，但是最长不得超过三个月 (Article 31: a taxpayer with special difficulty may defer payment with provincial approval, for no more than three months)
第三十二条：从滞纳税款之日起，按日加收滞纳税款万分之五的滞纳金 (Article 32: a late fee of 0.05% a day on tax paid late)
assumed: No late fee during an approved deferral, because the approval moves the deadline
Paid back in one sum at the end of the deferral
About 20 days for a decision. The real time depends on the local tax bureau
The upper limit of RMB 5 million is a modelling cap, not a legal one

products.name: Longer payment terms from an existing supplier
products.notes: Negotiated with a supplier you already use. Not a public product, so the cost is an assumption.

assumed: No public rate exists. Triody assumes a 1.5% cost, about the size of a lost early-payment discount
Suppliers rarely extend more than 3 months or more than RMB 250,000 for a small customer
